recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a seated subject overlaid with chaotic, expressive charcoal-style scribbles that wrap around the figure, creating a sense of internal turmoil or creative energy.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between clean studio photography and messy hand-drawn lines
Interaction of scribbles appearing both in front of and behind the subject
Subject's calm, detached expression versus the frantic movement of the lines
Monochromatic palette with a single sharp pop of red on the lips
coreInvariants: Charcoal or graphite texture for all line work
Subject seated cross-legged on the floor
Text integrated into the path of the scribbles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, full body seated, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the red lips, acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the circular, looping scribbles that spiral inward toward the subject's torso and face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the upper corners and around the perimeter to balance the central complexity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with very low saturation, except for the singular high-saturation red accent.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a pencil or charcoal stick
Characters follow the curved path of the scribbles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated into the line work so they appear 'caught' in the web
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style handwriting to maintain the 'sketchbook' aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tactile, messy quality of the scribbles
Provides a similar skeletal structure but would need more 'mess'

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution studio photograph of a young woman with blonde-streaked hair and red lips, wearing a distressed grey sweatshirt and ripped black jeans, sitting cross-legged on a pure white floor against a white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add chaotic, looping black charcoal scribbles that weave in front of and behind the subject. Incorporate handwritten uppercase text in a graphite texture that follows the curve of the scribbles on the left side of the subject's torso.

verificationChecks: Do the scribbles have a grainy, charcoal-like texture?
Is the text following a curved path?
Is the background pure white with no horizon line?
Does the subject have a single pop of red on the lips?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the text along the arcs
mustRedesign: The exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Dynamic movement in the line work

postGenerationChecks: Ensure scribbles overlap the subject naturally
Check that the text is legible despite the chaotic lines
Verify the high-contrast monochromatic feel is maintained
Confirm the charcoal texture looks physical rather than digital
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Pure White Backdrop + Charcoal Scribble Overlay + Path-Aligned Hand-Lettering
